moments.text: Side-by-side infrared (left) and electro-optical (right) views of buildings on desert ground, with green overlay lines and many black redaction boxes.
A short white streak crosses the upper right, from the right edge up-left toward a redaction box. 6 frames (~0.2 s): use frame step.
The right pane blanks, both panes flash white, then new ridged terrain appears with a large grey ellipse on the left.
The view jumps to flat desert with pale tracks across both panes; the ellipse now circles the crosshair.
The picture flashes black, white, then black for about 0.3 s.
A hazier grey view returns, with a smaller ellipse around the crosshair, until the clip ends.
